0022600040.text: The Warriors (8-4, 2nd in the Pacific, 6th in the West) are on the road against the Spurs (10-2, 1st in the Southwest, 2nd in the West) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group C game, with Golden State coming in on an 8-2 run over its last ten and San Antonio on a 10-game winning streak. Golden State is missing Brandon Williams (hamstring), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee surgery) as out, while Gary Payton II (knee inflammation) and Stephen Curry (abdomen soreness) are day-to-day and will be game-time decisions, and San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain) while Devin Vassell (groin) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, and the most recent meeting was a 127-113 Spurs win over the Warriors in San Francisco on April 1, 2026.
